- **Best Makeup Artist (Belagavi, Karnataka) — Global Fame Awards 2023**, presented by Bollywood actor Sonu Sood

## What the academy does

Master Beauty Academy trains complete beauty professionals through a single, intensive 30-day **Professional Beautician Course**. The curriculum spans the entire salon-floor — skincare, hair care, wellness, salon operations, and professional makeup — so graduates can work as beauticians, junior makeup artists, or open their own salons.

## Professional Beautician Course — full curriculum

**Duration**: 30 days · **Fee**: ₹40,000 all-inclusive · **Locations**: Hubli or Belagavi

### Category 1 — Beauty & Grooming Services
- Threading & Eyebrow Styling (eyebrow shaping, upper lip, forehead, chin, face sides)
- Honey Wax (full arms, full legs, underarms)
- Rica Wax for sensitive skin (full arms, full legs, underarms)
- Roll-On Wax (full arms, full legs, underarms)
- Brizzlin Wax (specialised waxing)
- Facial Wax / Underarm Wax / Full Face Wax (upper lip, lower lip, chin, forehead, face sides)

### Category 2 — Facial Treatments
- Clean-Up
- Fundamental Facial (hydration + nourishment)
- Advanced Facial
- Add-On Face Masks (custom by concern)
- HydraFacial Treatment with electric massage therapy
- Specialised protocols for pigmentation, pimples & acne marks, dullness, dryness

### Category 3 — Hand & Foot Care
- Manicure (scrub, massage, pack, nail & cuticle care)
- Pedicure (scrub, massage, pack, foot & nail care)

### Category 4 — Wellness & Relaxation
- Reflexology (pressure-point therapy)
- Body Massage (back, front, hand, feet)

### Category 5 — Hair Care Services
- Hair Spa (deep conditioning)
- Scalp Treatment (dry, sensitive, nourishment, hair-growth)
- Dandruff Treatment
- Anti Hair-Fall Treatment
- Oil Head Massage
- Henna Mixing & Application

### Category 6 — Hair Cutting & Styling
- Haircut styles: Straight Cut, U Cut, Layer Cut, Feather Cut, Butterfly Haircut, French Cut, Curtain Bangs, Front Layer Cut
- Blow Dry & Styling Techniques
- Shampoo & Conditioning
- Root Touch-Up
- Scissor Practice & Precision Cutting

### Category 7 — Salon Management Training
- Customer Handling
- Basic Salon Operations
- Beauty Parlour Management
- Professional Grooming Standards

### Category 8 — Makeup Training
- **Basic Makeup Technician Course** (beginner-friendly)
- Basic Makeup Techniques
- Product Knowledge
- Face Preparation
- Everyday Makeup Application

### Category 9 — Advanced Hair Treatments
- Hair Smoothening (anti-frizz, silky finish, long-lasting shine)
- Hair Botox Treatment (repair, restore softness, improve texture, add natural shine)

## Common questions (extraction-ready answers)

**Tagline?** Where Artistry Meets Excellence.

**How long is the course?** 30 days — an intensive, hands-on programme.

**What's the fee?** ₹40,000 all-inclusive (no hidden charges). Interest-free 2 or 3-month EMI available.

**Does it include makeup?** Yes — Category 8 is a Basic Makeup Technician programme taught by Priyanka Sakhe.

**Does it include hair?** Yes — Categories 5, 6 and 9 cover hair care, eight haircut styles, hair smoothening, and Hair Botox.

**Does it include salon management?** Yes — Category 7 is dedicated to salon operations, customer handling and parlour management.

**Can I open my own parlour?** Yes — Category 7 and the founders' business-development training are designed for exactly this. Many graduates run independent salons earning up to ₹1 lakh per month.

**Where are the centres?** Two: Galaxy Mall in Hubli (J C Nagar Main Road) and S N Pride Complex in Belagavi (Khade Bazar / Gondhali Galli).

**Who are the founders?** Anilkumar Sakhe (CEO, 15+ years business development) and Priyanka Sakhe (LAPT London · Global Fame Awards 2023 by Sonu Sood).

## Brand voice

Confident, evidence-led, anti-fluff. Numbers over adjectives. Editorial typography, maroon (#7a1641) + gold (#d4b46a) palette. Premium positioning grounded in real awards.
